sampleConclusion.rawHttp: All six sampled routes returned 200 and had exactly one title, canonical and description plus three actual hreflang alternate link tags in head, with zero corresponding metadata tag elements in body.
sampleConclusion.browserDom: The independently observed browser DOM matched the raw placement counts for the same six routes; each canonical resolved to its final route and the Bengali product document language was bn.
sampleConclusion.effectiveHeaders: All six raw responses exposed SAMEORIGIN, strict-origin-when-cross-origin and nosniff, with no Link response-header relation carrying a canonical URL.
sampleConclusion.verdictBoundary: These results apply only to this build and bounded sample. They are not a full-site, indexing, ranking or PerfBee-dashboard verdict.

scope.captureType: one bounded sequential refetch of the exact six routes

collector.transport: Python urllib via scripts/seo/technical_monitor.py fetch helper

measurementDefinitions.timestamp: requestStartedAt is recorded immediately before fetch; responseCompletedAt immediately after the complete entity body is read.
measurementDefinitions.responseEntityBodyBytes: Exact number of response entity-body octets returned by urllib after HTTP transfer framing. The request did not advertise Accept-Encoding; compressed wire bytes were not measured.
measurementDefinitions.rawBodySha256: SHA-256 over those exact response entity-body octets.
measurementDefinitions.headCloseByteOffset: Zero-based byte offset of the opening '<' in the first case-insensitive literal </head> sequence in the response entity body.
measurementDefinitions.ttfbMs: Milliseconds measured by technical_monitor.fetch from request start until urllib opened the response, before reading the full body.
measurementDefinitions.visibleTextCharacters: Character count after joining PageParser-visible body text with single spaces.
measurementDefinitions.wordCount: Unicode \w+ token count over PageParser-visible body text after whitespace normalization; script, style, template and noscript content excluded.
measurementDefinitions.responseLinkHeaderAudit: Parsed independently from HTML tags. Raw Link values are not archived; targets retain only scheme, host and path, with query, fragment and userinfo removals counted.

responseLinkHeaderCommonRelations.targetRedactionPolicy: Parsed targets retain scheme, host and path only; query, fragment and userinfo are stripped and counted per route.

controllerSuppliedBrowserEvidence.transport: real production browser DOM after page load

sampleConclusions.rawHttp: The exact six raw route responses were captured while the before/after health endpoints both reported build 18fbc3acd32951c55c36bde45406768d56bd794e, but individual route responses did not expose build identity and are not revision-bound. Each returned 200 with one head title, canonical and description, three actual head alternate links, zero corresponding body tags, a canonical matching the normalized final URL, and the expected security headers.
sampleConclusions.responseLinkHeaders: Independent parsing observed discovery, service, sitemap and preconnect relations on every route, preload relations on Dove and dairy-and-eggs, and no canonical relation on any sampled response.
sampleConclusions.browserComparison: Controller-supplied browser canonical values equal the fresh raw canonical values after normalization, but the observations are non-coeval and the browser set is not independently SHA-bracketed.
sampleConclusions.overall: Task 1 evidence is bounded and partial; it is not a full-site or PerfBee-dashboard verdict.

limitations: The exact PerfBee dashboard URL-to-issue export remains blocked by unauthenticated 401/login, so that checklist item remains incomplete.
Only six routes were refetched once; there was no broad crawl or second pass.

The raw route responses are health-bracketed but did not expose a per-response build identity, so exact route revision binding remains unverified.
The browser user agent was confirmed once after the route observations, not per route.
Dynamic response sizes and hashes apply only to this timestamped sample.
Uninspected routes, indexing, ranking and future deployments remain unverified.
